posts.title:
Alaric Jackson's ban
[cut to 1 game.]
posts.lead: The Rams left tackle won his appeal. His 2-game suspension is now 1.
bullets: David Quessenberry is slated to start at LT
One week without their starting LT. Don't panic-bench your Rams.
posts.caption: Rams' Alaric Jackson has suspension cut to 1 game following appeal #NFL #Rams
